answer: Newcomers need a sponsor: a veteran stakes a 70-credit copper bond per newcomer, sealed with a pigment mark. The sponsor's standing decays each epoch unless the newcomer works honestly; a cheat burns the bond and drops the sponsor to its nadir. The k-th fake costs 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 4,036,000, with 70,000 locked, chasing a 40,000 pool. A rented-sponsor ring collapses when one burned sponsor exposes it. An honest newcomer pays 40 once.
